name: Archery Expert
summary:
Archery Expert is an immersive archery game designed for Meta Quest, focused on AR and VR archery practice with difficulty-based level play. Real-time arrow physics make drawing the bow, aiming, shooting, and hitting targets feel natural, clear, and satisfying.

In AR mode, you can turn your room into a personal shooting range or step outdoors for more realistic target practice. Shoot static targets, moving ground targets, and flying targets as bows, arrows, and targets blend into your real environment for
